details: Hackers have targeted water and wastewater utilities in at least a dozen US states, with American authorities suspecting Iran as the main culprit. While no widespread disruptions to water supplies have been reported, the attacks caused a loss of monitoring and control functionality in some systems, raising concerns about critical infrastructure security.
title: US Water Systems Hit by Suspected Iranian Cyberattacks

details: Ukrainian drones have hit two Russian oil refineries, including a major one in Yaroslavl Oblast, which was targeted for the second consecutive night. These long-range strikes aim to disrupt Russia's oil revenues, which are crucial for financing its war efforts. Russian strikes on Ukrainian cities and shipping continue as well.
title: Ukraine Drones Strike Russian Oil Refineries, Escalating Economic Pressure

details: Iran and Oman are reportedly close to finalizing a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a crucial global shipping route. Reports suggest Iran would gain control over inbound maritime traffic, a significant concession. The agreement is seen as a step towards a broader ceasefire between the US and Iran and could lead to the lifting of US blockades on Iranian ports. Oil prices have shown some easing on these hopes, though significant details on control and cargo fees are still being negotiated.
title: Iran and Oman Nearing Deal to Reopen Strait of Hormuz
